rows.role_title: State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Government Gazette of 2 February 1990 prints a commission to Mr Justice L. T. C. Harms and Proclamation No. R. 16, 1990 (Commission of Inquiry into Certain Alleged Murders), both given at Cape Town on 2 February 1990 and signed by F. W. de Klerk as State President, by order of the State President-in-Cabinet (countersigned H. J. Coetsee). Proclamation No. R. 17, 1990 on page 6 carries the same dated signature.

locator.items: Commission to Mr Justice L. T. C. Harms (pp. 1-2); Proclamation No. R. 16, 1990 (p. 2, English right-hand column); Proclamation No. R. 17, 1990 (p. 6)
